description: Composed deck report: format legality (with per-issue detail: size, copy limits, sideboard, banned and restricted cards, commander and pairing rules, colour identity — pdh and dc by their own lists — and the companion's condition, naming each card that breaks it; deck.companion names the companion), missing cards, shared-copy disclosures (copies this deck borrows AND its own copies that other decks borrow — relay both), proxy count, and price-to-complete in `currency` (default USD). Proxies never affect legality but are always reported as a warning.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name: deck_health

companion.description: The companion's name, or null; legality names each card that breaks its condition

code.description: `proxies` is the warning that the list holds proxies: always relay it. On a casual deck it says the deck is not tournament legal; on a tournament deck, that its proxies count as missing

legal.description: The list against its format's rules. Proxies never affect it: the proxies warning says what they cost

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

proxies_missing.description: Of missing, on a tournament deck: copies it plays as proxies. Say "you play a proxy; a tournament needs the real card"

scryfall_url.description: The cheapest priced printing, else the card by name: link the name to it

rate_missing.description: Present when CHF was asked and no CHF rate is stored: no CHF price could be given at all, the cards are not unpriced. Relay it.

unpriced_cards.description: Missing copies with no price, left out of amount: say how many

shared_copies.description: Copies this deck borrows and its own copies other decks borrow: relay every line

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

title: Deck health
